body: {"better": "A", "reason": "Card A clearly says when to leave (బయలుదేరి) and includes the important first walk instruction 'వరకు నడిచి' (walk to), while Card B omits the initial 1-minute walk and uses vague 'దగ్గర' (near) for stops instead of precise get-on/get-off language. Card A also better captures the 'small, friendly group' aspect with 'స్వచ్ఛందంగా' suggesting comfortable voluntary participation, versus Card B's generic 'అందరితో కలిసి' (with everyone)."}
